## Why This Matters
Palo Alto-headquartered AI-software company (Dheyo AI Inc.) with an India office in Hyderabad; listed on the Chips-DLI portal. No chip design or tape-out found — its products are AI compilers, GPU scheduling and video-generation software.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Generative-AI software: compilers, heterogeneous-compute scheduling and video generation. Not a chip designer.
